messages.subject: Some options were removed in 0.5.16?
parts:
Dear all.

I want to use options "auto.var=TRUE, auto.fix.first=TRUE, auto.cov.lv.x=TRUE" in my SEM models.

But, It was not running with this error.

Error in sem(oi.ipo, data = OI.full, estimator = "MLM", auto.var = TRUE,  : 
  unused arguments (auto.var = TRUE, auto.fix.first = TRUE, auto.cov.lv.x = TRUE)

They were removed in 0.5.16?

I can not replicate the same result when I use that option in my SEM models.

Please Somebody gives advices to me.

--
Seongho Bae

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Some options were removed in 0.5.16?
parts:
On 04/10/2014 02:10 PM, Seongho Bae wrote:
> Dear all.
>
> I want to use options "auto.var=TRUE, auto.fix.first=TRUE,
> auto.cov.lv.x=TRUE" in my SEM models.
>
> But, It was not running with this error.
>
> Error insem(oi.ipo, data = OI.full, estimator = "MLM", auto.var = TRUE, :
> unused arguments (auto.var = TRUE, auto.fix.first = TRUE, auto.cov.lv.x = TRUE)

The auto.* options are only available for the lavaan() function, not the
sem() function. This has always been the case.

Yves.
